text:
liz: Heads-up — we've got a recurring reconciliation alert where "late credits" arrive after a billing window is finalized and then bump accounts negative.

samir: Ugh, seen this. Is it specifically the finalize -> compact step losing context?

liz: Looks like it. The pipeline marks window FINAL at T, then compact/rollup runs. An arriving credit event with event_time < T but ingestion_time > T isn't applied. Reconciler flags mismatch.

jess: Can you paste a minimal example?

liz: Sure:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_abc","customer_id":"acct_42","type":"credit","amount":-3,"event_time":"2026-02-20T14:02:10Z","ingest_time":"2026-02-20T14:12:03Z","provenance":{"source":"edge-proxy","seq":12345}}
```
This arrives 10m after finalization.

mike: Two orthogonal problems: late arrivals + finalization being destructive (we compact away raw events).

kevin: Options: keep raw events longer (storage), allow compact to ingest late deltas, or add a handshake/ack path so upstream retries patch missing aggregates.

samir: I sketched a handshake idea: when finalizing window W we emit a finalize-token {window_id, watermark} and store a short-lived tombstone that allows compaction to accept upserts for X minutes. Upserts outside X become "late credits" audit events that reconciler can apply with an explicit correction delta.

jess: So compaction becomes upsert-friendly for the grace period. That avoids storing raw forever. How do we ensure idempotency for upserts?

samir: Include idempotency_key = event_id in the compacted row. Compact logic: if incoming event_id already applied, ignore. Also maintain last_seen_ingest_time to prevent older duplicates from rewinding.

liz: Another wrinkle: we charge customers immediately at consume time, so a late negative credit needs to produce a billing correction item and possibly a credit memo. We need audit to show why balance changed.

kevin: We should also differentiate two flows: soft late (within grace) -> automatic apply + audit note. Hard late (after grace or cross-account corrections) -> put into "billing-corrections" queue for manual review + automated reconciliation run.

mike: Performance/complexity tradeoff: keeping compaction upsert-capable adds write amplification and slightly more complex merge logic. But allows near-real-time corrections without backfill jobs. I lean towards short grace period (e.g., 15m) and automatic upsert + audit.

jess: How about API/ingest contract changes? We might need to surface a sequence/ack header so proxies can retry or send explicit correction flags.

samir: Proposed lightweight contract: incoming events include provenance.seq + event_id + ingest_time. We'll accept out-of-order event_time but use ingest_time and event_id for idempotency. Also emit "finalize_token" when window is finalizing to observability and replicas.

liz: Implementation checklist I can take on: update compacting consumer to accept "grace window" config, add idempotency_key column, add audit-row emit for applied late events, and add metric for "late_applied_count" vs "late_escalated_count".

kevin: I'll do the finalize_token and tombstone store + make sure the token is visible in console traces. Also add a flag to disable auto-apply per-customer for enterprise accounts that require manual corrections.

mike: For reconciler: add a job that picks up events labeled correction and replays into invoices, creating a correction transaction linked to the original event_id. Include a small UI view for ops with proposed correction and justification.

jess: One more safety: if compaction logic fails to apply a late upsert due to schema drift, emit a high-priority alert to billing-pager. Don't let silent failures bite us.

liz: Sounds good. Quick questions: grace period default 15m? retention of tombstone 1h?

samir: default 15m, tombstone 1h seems reasonable to cover retries + clock skew. We'll make both configurable.

kevin: I'll open a tiny RFC to capture the finalize-token format and API changes. Link it here when ready. :+1:

billing-bot: reminder: Running reconciliation job "weekly-billing-audit" in 2h.

mike: Ok. Plan: (1) Samir RFC for finalize_token + idempotency contract, (2) Liz implements compaction upsert + metrics, (3) Kevin exposes token and per-customer disable flag, (4) Jess adds alert on compaction upsert failures, (5) Reconciler update to apply corrections. Iterate after one-week canary.

liz: I'll start a PR for compactor changes and tag @samir and @kevin once ready. Thanks all. :heart:
